_comment: Original characters for OPERATION SHADOW. Speaker ids are used by mission dialogue.

halden.name: Pvt. Tomas Halden
halden.bio: Nineteen years old and eight months into his service, Halden was posted to the quietest stretch of the northern frontier. He has never fired a shot outside the range.

crane.name: Elias Crane
crane.bio: Dismissed from Republic Intelligence after a failed operation he was blamed for, Crane now works alone. He believes the invasion is a cover for something far worse.

marek.name: Sgt. Ilya Marek
marek.bio: A twenty-year veteran who asked for a quiet posting. Gruff, careful, and fiercely protective of his soldiers.

voss.name: Cpl. Nadia Voss
voss.bio: The best shot in the company. Calm under fire and sparing with words.

kell.name: Pvt. Jonah Kell
kell.bio: Halden's friend from basic training. Jokes when he is nervous, which is often.

doran.name: Pvt. Rafe Doran
doran.bio: A quarry blaster before the war. Talks about explosives the way other people talk about music.

wren.name: Isa Wren
wren.role: Former intelligence analyst, Crane's eyes on the network
wren.bio: Quit the service the week Crane was dismissed. Works from a rented room full of borrowed radios and stolen passwords.

brandt.name: Lio Brandt
brandt.bio: Copied one shipping manifest he was never meant to see, and has been running ever since.

drevan.name: Director-General Kasimir Drevan
drevan.bio: Rose through the Directorate's security service. Has ruled Varn for eleven years without ever giving a speech.

kade.name: Gen. Teodor Kade
kade.bio: Young for a general. Planned the invasion down to the hour.

ostrova.name: Gen. Anton Ostrova
ostrova.bio: Fought in the last war. The only man in the room who remembers how it ended.

venn.name: Deputy Director Alda Venn
venn.bio: Ran the inquiry into Operation Glass Harbour.

rusk.name: Lt. Anya Rusk
rusk.bio: Commands the last platoon on Kesh Ridge. Her family is among the people still waiting in the town below.

hammer.name: Hammer (Mortar Section)
hammer.role: Radio callsign of the ridge mortar team

lind.name: Dr. Ora Lind
lind.bio: Runs the last field hospital in Veyra out of three tents and a truck.

bastion.name: Bastion (Sector Command)
bastion.role: Radio callsign of Northern Sector Command

mira.name: Mira Sol
mira.bio: She sold to everyone, until she learned what the buyers of Project TEMPEST intended.
